# Observational Recent Changes — sandbox prototype

Prototype drop-in replacement for `barplot_recentChanges` / `warmingStripes_recentChanges` in the main `climateRationale` notebook. Driven by the observational CHIRPS v3 + CHIRTS-ERA5 monthly admin1 parquet (not the NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 hindcast).

Earlier Stage 1 QAQC + COG spot-checks are archived at [`archive/obs_qaqc_full.qmd`](archive/obs_qaqc_full.qmd) — out of scope here.

## Data sources

- **PTOT** ← [CHIRPS v3](https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps)
- **TAVG / TMAX / TMIN** ← [CHIRTS-era5](https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirtsdaily) (CHIRTS temperature, ERA5-based variant)
- **SPEI-01 / -03 / -06 / -12 / -24** ← derived from CHIRPS precip + PET from CHIRTS-era5
- Parquets: `s3://digital-atlas/.../processing=admin-{monthly,periods}/variable=adm{0,1}_obs.parquet`

## Design rules (per the 2026-05-20 dispatch)

- Baseline window: **1991-2020** exclusively (WMO normals + SPEI standardisation).
- **No per-year ±SD ribbon** — observational data is a single realisation, not an ensemble.
- **Temperature (TMAX/TMIN/TAVG) and PTOT**: ±1σ + ±2σ horizontal reference bands centred on the 1991-2020 baseline mean. Bands are subordinate to the observed line.
- **SPEI-03 / SPEI-12**: already standardised by the pipeline. No σ bands. Reference lines at ±1 / ±1.5 / ±2 (WMO moderate / severe / extreme). Anomaly toggle suppressed.
- **SPEI season mapping**: for season MAM → SPEI-03 at month = 5 (the 3-month accumulation ending in May). Annual → SPEI-12 at month = 12. The system derives the month index from the season's last month, independent of which SPEI scale is selected.
- **Extreme highlighting**: `|z| > 2` or `|SPEI| > 1.5` → extreme; `|z| > 1` or `|SPEI| > 1` → unusual. Same palette as `bars_extremeEvents` for visual continuity.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
obsBase = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/";
monthlyAdm0URL = obsBase + "processing=admin-monthly/variable=adm0_obs.parquet";
monthlyAdm1URL = obsBase + "processing=admin-monthly/variable=adm1_obs.parquet";
periodsAdm0URL = obsBase + "processing=admin-periods/variable=adm0_obs.parquet";
periodsAdm1URL = obsBase + "processing=admin-periods/variable=adm1_obs.parquet";

// DuckDB-WASM (httpfs is built-in for the WASM build; no INSTALL/LOAD needed).
db = await DuckDBClient.of();
```

## Controls

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Hardcoded country selector (sandbox scope). Production view will reuse
// components/_adminSelectors.qmd; here we only need a few known countries
// to spot-check observational data quality.
countries = [
  { iso3: "AGO", name: "Angola" },
  { iso3: "TGO", name: "Togo"   },
  { iso3: "KEN", name: "Kenya"  },
];
```

```{ojs}
viewof country = Inputs.select(countries, {
  label: "Country",
  format: (d) => `${d.iso3} — ${d.name}`,
});
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// CR-075 short-term filter — pick the main-country gaul0_code per iso3
// (the one with the largest admin1 count). Disputed-territory polygons
// each carry exactly 1 admin1, so this reliably drops Bīr Ṭawīl /
// Hala'ib / Ilemi / Abyei from the adm0 query results.
mainGaul = {
  const resp = await db.query(`
    WITH per_polygon AS (
      SELECT iso3, gaul0_code, COUNT(DISTINCT admin1_name) AS n_admin1
      FROM read_parquet('${monthlyAdm1URL}')
      GROUP BY iso3, gaul0_code
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT iso3, gaul0_code,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iso3 ORDER BY n_admin1 DESC) AS rn
      FROM per_polygon
    )
    SELECT iso3, gaul0_code FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
  `);
  const map = new Map();
  for (const row of resp) map.set(row.iso3, row.gaul0_code);
  return map;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof admin1_names = {
  // Multi-select admin1. Empty selection = country (national) view.
  // 1 admin1 = single-region timeseries + map zoom. 2+ = map shows
  // them all (mask + boundaries), timeseries falls back to country
  // aggregate (no automatic averaging — would be misleading for
  // mixed precipitation totals across regions of different sizes).
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) {
    return Inputs.select([], { label: "Region(s) — admin1 (empty = country)", multiple: 8, value: [] });
  }
  const resp = await db.query(`
    SELECT DISTINCT admin1_name FROM read_parquet('${monthlyAdm1URL}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}' AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
    ORDER BY admin1_name
  `);
  const options = Array.from(resp).map((d) => d.admin1_name);
  return Inputs.select(options, { label: "Region(s) — admin1 (empty = country)", multiple: 8, value: [] });
}

viewof variable_E = Inputs.select(
  ["TAVG", "TMAX", "TMIN", "PTOT", "SPEI-03", "SPEI-12"],
  { label: "Variable", value: "TAVG" }
);

viewof season_E = Inputs.select(
  ["annual","JFM","FMA","MAM","AMJ","MJJ","JJA","JAS","ASO","SON","OND","NDJ","DJF"],
  { label: "Season", value: "annual" }
);

viewof viewType_E = Inputs.select(
  ["periods", "monthly"],
  { label: "View Type", value: "periods", format: (d) => d === "periods" ? "Annual / season" : "Monthly" }
);

viewof anomaly_E = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Show as anomaly (vs 1991-2020)", value: false });

// Map-only toggle: dynamic ramp rescales each render to the visible
// data range (max contrast within a view); fixed ramp keeps the
// 0–40°C / 0–2500 mm / SPEI-sd absolute limits (cross-region
// comparable). Doesn't affect the timeseries chart.
viewof rampLockFixed_E = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Lock map ramp to global limits (off = rescale to admin1 / country data)", value: false });

// Map decoration toggles.
viewof showGraticule_E    = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Show lat/lon ticks on map", value: false });
viewof showAdmin1Labels_E = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Show admin1 names on map",   value: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
isSPEI_E = variable_E.startsWith("SPEI");
useAnomaly_E = anomaly_E && !isSPEI_E;
seasonLastMonth = ({
  annual: 12, JFM: 3, FMA: 4, MAM: 5, AMJ: 6, MJJ: 7, JJA: 8, JAS: 9,
```

## Timeseries

```{ojs}
//| output: false
observed_E_raw = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) return [];
  // Single-admin1 selection → query at admin1. Empty OR 2+ → query at
  // country (no admin1 filter). Map can still show multi-admin1
  // visually; the chart deliberately doesn't try to average them.
  const isAdmin1 = admin1_names.length === 1;
  const adminName = isAdmin1 ? admin1_names[0] : null;
  const baseURL = isAdmin1 ? monthlyAdm1URL : monthlyAdm0URL;
  const periodsURL = isAdmin1 ? periodsAdm1URL : periodsAdm0URL;

  let q;
  if (isSPEI_E) {
    const mo = seasonLastMonth[season_E];
    q = `
      SELECT year, month, value_mean
      FROM read_parquet('${baseURL}')
      WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
        AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
        ${isAdmin1 ? `AND admin1_name = '${adminName.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : ""}
        AND variable = '${variable_E}'
        AND month = ${mo}
        AND value_mean IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(value_mean)
      ORDER BY year
    `;
  } else if (viewType_E === "monthly") {
    q = `
      SELECT year, month, value_mean
      FROM read_parquet('${baseURL}')
      WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
        AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
        ${isAdmin1 ? `AND admin1_name = '${adminName.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : ""}
        AND variable = '${variable_E}'
        AND value_mean IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(value_mean)
      ORDER BY year, month
    `;
  } else {
    q = `
      SELECT year, value_mean
      FROM read_parquet('${periodsURL}')
      WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
        AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
        ${isAdmin1 ? `AND admin1_name = '${adminName.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : ""}
        AND variable = '${variable_E}'
        AND period = '${season_E}'
        AND value_mean IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(value_mean)
      ORDER BY year
    `;
  }
  const resp = await db.query(q);
  return Array.from(resp);
}

baseline_E = {
  const baseline = observed_E_raw.filter((d) => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020);
  if (baseline.length === 0) return { mean: 0, sd: 0, n: 0 };
  const vals = baseline.map((d) => d.value_mean);
  const mean = d3.mean(vals);
  const sd = d3.deviation(vals) ?? 0;
  return { mean, sd, n: vals.length };
}

observed_E = observed_E_raw.map((d) => {
  const v = useAnomaly_E ? d.value_mean - baseline_E.mean : d.value_mean;
  const z = baseline_E.sd > 0 ? (d.value_mean - baseline_E.mean) / baseline_E.sd : 0;
  let cls = "normal";
  if (isSPEI_E) {
    const av = Math.abs(d.value_mean);
    if (av >= 1.5) cls = "extreme";
    else if (av >= 1) cls = "unusual";
  } else {
    const az = Math.abs(z);
    if (az >= 2) cls = "extreme";
    else if (az >= 1) cls = "unusual";
  }
  const year_frac = d.month != null ? d.year + (d.month - 1) / 12 : d.year;
  return { ...d, value_plot: v, z, cls, year_frac };
});
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Standalone cell — splitting from the multi-statement cell above keeps
// Quarto's OJS preprocessor from dropping the parens around the object
// literal (see commit 46ffda9).
extremeColour_E = ({ normal: "#bbbbbb", unusual: "#f4a261", extreme: "#e15759" });
```

```{ojs}
recentChanges_E = {
  if (observed_E.length === 0) return html`<div style="padding: 1em; color: #999;">No data for this selection.</div>`;

  // SPEI is its own named quantity — the values plotted come straight
  // from the parquet, we don't z-score anything ourselves. Labelling
  // "(z-score)" implied a transform we don't perform.
  const unit = isSPEI_E ? ""
    : variable_E === "PTOT" ? (viewType_E === "monthly" ? "(mm / month)" : "(mm / period)")
    : "(°C)";
  const yLabel = isSPEI_E
    ? variable_E
    : (useAnomaly_E ? `${variable_E} anomaly ${unit}` : `${variable_E} ${unit}`);

  const meanForBands = useAnomaly_E ? 0 : baseline_E.mean;
  const bands = (!isSPEI_E && baseline_E.sd > 0) ? [
    { y1: meanForBands - 2 * baseline_E.sd, y2: meanForBands + 2 * baseline_E.sd, fill: "rgba(70,130,180,0.10)" },
    { y1: meanForBands - baseline_E.sd,     y2: meanForBands + baseline_E.sd,     fill: "rgba(70,130,180,0.18)" },
  ] : [];

  const speiLines = isSPEI_E ? [
    { y: -2,   stroke: "#e15759" },
    { y: -1.5, stroke: "#e15759" },
    { y: -1,   stroke: "#f4a261" },
    { y:  0,   stroke: "#999"    },
    { y:  1,   stroke: "#76b7b2" },
    { y:  1.5, stroke: "#76b7b2" },
    { y:  2,   stroke: "#76b7b2" },
  ] : [];

  const xField = viewType_E === "monthly" || (isSPEI_E && viewType_E === "monthly") ? "year_frac" : "year";

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1200,
    height: 380,
    marginLeft: 70,
    marginBottom: 50,
    marginTop: 30,
    style: { color: "#333", background: "#fff" },
    x: { label: "Year", tickFormat: (d) => `${Math.floor(d)}` },
    y: { label: yLabel, grid: true, nice: true },
    marks: [
      ...bands.map((b) =>
        Plot.rect([b], {
          x1: d3.min(observed_E, (d) => d[xField]),
          x2: d3.max(observed_E, (d) => d[xField]),
          y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "fill",
        })
      ),
      ...(!isSPEI_E ? [Plot.ruleY([meanForBands], { stroke: "#4682b4", strokeDasharray: "3,2" })] : []),
      ...speiLines.map((l) =>
        Plot.ruleY([l.y], { stroke: l.stroke, strokeDasharray: "2,3" })
      ),
      ...(isSPEI_E
        ? [
            Plot.barY(observed_E, {
              x: xField,
              y: "value_plot",
              fill: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              stroke: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              channels: { year: "year", value: "value_mean", classification: "cls" },
              tip: true,
            }),
          ]
        : [
            Plot.line(observed_E, { x: xField, y: "value_plot", stroke: "#333", strokeWidth: 1 }),
            Plot.dot(observed_E, {
              x: xField,
              y: "value_plot",
              r: 2.5,
              fill: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              stroke: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              channels: { year: "year", value: "value_mean", anomaly: "value_plot", z: "z", classification: "cls" },
              tip: true,
            }),
          ]),
    ],
  });

  // Hand off to the shared chartDownloadMenu helper — split-button
  // sits below the chart with PNG (default) + SVG + CSV in the
  // dropdown. CSV exports the dataframe currently driving the chart.
  const regionToken = admin1_names.length === 1
    ? admin1_names[0]
    : admin1_names.length > 1
      ? `${country.iso3}-multi${admin1_names.length}`
      : country.iso3;
  const filename = `obs_chart_${country.iso3}_${regionToken}_${variable_E}_${season_E}_${viewType_E}`
    .split(" ").join("_");
  return chartDownloadMenu(chart, {
    filename,
    data: observed_E,
    csvColumns: ["year", "month", "value_mean", "value_plot", "z", "cls"],
  });
}

recentChanges_caption_E = {
  const speiMonth = isSPEI_E ? seasonLastMonth[season_E] : null;
  const region = admin1_names.length === 1
    ? `${admin1_names[0]}, ${country.name}`
    : admin1_names.length > 1
      ? `${country.name} (national — map shows ${admin1_names.length} admin1 regions)`
      : `${country.name} (national)`;
  const baselineCopy = baseline_E.n > 0
    ? `Baseline (1991-2020): μ = ${baseline_E.mean.toFixed(2)}, σ = ${baseline_E.sd.toFixed(2)}, n = ${baseline_E.n} years.`
    : `Baseline (1991-2020): insufficient data.`;
  const speiCopy = isSPEI_E
    ? `SPEI is the ${variable_E.replace("SPEI-","").replace(/^0+/, "")}-month accumulation ending in month ${speiMonth}. Reference lines: ±1 moderate, ±1.5 severe, ±2 extreme (WMO).`
    : "";
  return md`
*Region: **${region}** · Variable: **${variable_E}** · Season: **${season_E}** · View: **${viewType_E}**${useAnomaly_E ? " · **anomaly mode**" : ""}*

${baselineCopy} ${speiCopy}
  `;
}
```

## Map (interactive — geotiff.js + canvas)

Reads the COG directly from S3 via geotiff.js (HTTP Range requests under the hood — only the bytes for the country bbox get fetched, not the full Africa-wide raster). Pixels render into an offscreen canvas at the COG's native resolution, then up-sampled onto the visible canvas with the browser's built-in bilinear smoothing. Admin0 + admin1 outlines are overlaid as SVG paths using the same `(lon, lat) → (px_x, px_y)` projection.

**Admin1 behaviour** (multi-select): empty selection = country (national) view. One admin1 = zoom + mask + red boundary accent. Two or more = zoom + mask to the union of all selected admin1s, each accented. The country-level COG pixels stay cached in memory — switching admin1 selections re-crops the existing array client-side, with **no second HTTP fetch**. Changing the country / variable / season triggers a new COG download.

**Boundaries**: all of the current country's admin1 boundaries are drawn as thin gray lines for context. Selected admin1s get a red accent on top of a white halo so the selection is obvious against any colour ramp. The country outline is *not* drawn separately — it would misalign against the admin1 layer by 1–3 px (the two topojson files are simplified independently). The admin1 union traces the country shape naturally.

**Mask**: pixels outside the active polygon (union of all admin1s if none selected; union of selected admin1s otherwise) are clipped to the canvas background — only the AoI's data is painted. The mask and the boundary layer come from the same admin1 simplification, so they align perfectly.

**Ramp**: dynamic by default — the colour ramp rescales to the visible data range for maximum contrast in each view. Flip the "Lock map ramp to global limits" toggle to use the fixed cross-region scale (0–40 °C, 0–2500 mm, etc.) for cross-region comparison.

**Download**: the map has a "Download map (PNG)" button that composites the canvas + boundary overlay into a single PNG (white background). The timeseries chart uses the shared `chartDownloadMenu` helper from `/helpers/chartDownloadMenu.ojs` — primary click = PNG (2× DPR), caret dropdown = SVG (vector) or CSV (the dataframe driving the chart).

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// natively and resolves each cell to the module namespace, which

// esm.sh passthrough verified for both packages on 2026-05-20
// (no `x-esm-build` header on either response → no CJS rewriter
// involved; both packages ship native ESM in dist-module/).
GeoTIFF_E        = await import("https://esm.sh/geotiff@2.1.3");
topojsonClient_E = await import("https://esm.sh/topojson-client@3.1.0");
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
admin0_geo_E = {
  const tj = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a0_africa_simple-vlowres.topojson").json();
  const objectName = Object.keys(tj.objects)[0];
  return topojsonClient_E.feature(tj, tj.objects[objectName]);
}

admin0_feature_E = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const f = admin0_geo_E.features.find((f) => f.properties && (f.properties.iso3 === iso3 || f.properties.ISO3 === iso3 || f.properties.iso_3 === iso3));
  return f ?? null;
}

admin1_geo_E = {
  const tj = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a1_africa_simple-vlowres.topojson").json();
  const objectName = Object.keys(tj.objects)[0];
  return topojsonClient_E.feature(tj, tj.objects[objectName]);
}

// admin1 polygons for the currently-selected admin1_names array.
// Returns an array (possibly empty). Match is on (iso3, admin1_name).
admin1_features_E = {
  if (!admin1_names || admin1_names.length === 0) return [];
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  return admin1_names
    .map((name) => admin1_geo_E.features.find((f) =>
      f.properties &&
      f.properties.iso3 === iso3 &&
      f.properties.admin1_name === name
    ))
    .filter((f) => f != null);
}

cogURL_for_E = ({ variable, season, clim = "1991-2020", stat = "mean" }) => {
  // CR-076: all COGs land in a single physical directory regardless of
  // their (variable × period × clim × stat) tokens. Construct against
  // that single directory and let the filename carry the metadata.
  const dir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=climatology/variable=PTOT/period=AMJ/clim=wmo_1991-2020/stat=max";
  return `${dir}/${variable}_${season}_${clim}_${stat}.tif`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Standalone cell so any preprocessor weirdness here can't take down the
// upstream loader cells (see commit history around extremeColour_E).
// SPEI 1991-2020 *mean* is ~0 by construction (standardisation window),
// so switch SPEI to stat=sd to show real spatial variability.
mapStat_E = variable_E.startsWith("SPEI") ? "sd" : "mean";
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Reusable colour-ramp helper. stops sorted by `at`; linear RGB
// interpolation between adjacent stops; clamps at endpoints; returns
// null (transparent) for NaN / non-finite values.
colorRamp_E = (value, stops) => {
  if (value == null || !isFinite(value)) return null;
  if (value <= stops[0].at) return [...stops[0].rgb, 255];
  const last = stops[stops.length - 1];
  if (value >= last.at) return [...last.rgb, 255];
  for (let i = 0; i < stops.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = stops[i], b = stops[i + 1];
    if (value >= a.at && value <= b.at) {
      const t = (value - a.at) / (b.at - a.at);
      return [
        Math.round(a.rgb[0] + t * (b.rgb[0] - a.rgb[0])),
        Math.round(a.rgb[1] + t * (b.rgb[1] - a.rgb[1])),
        Math.round(a.rgb[2] + t * (b.rgb[2] - a.rgb[2])),
        255,
      ];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

ramps_E = ({
  // Sequential viridis-like for absolute temperature
  TAVG: [
    { at:  0, rgb: [ 68,   1,  84] },
    { at: 10, rgb: [ 59,  82, 139] },
    { at: 20, rgb: [ 32, 144, 140] },
    { at: 25, rgb: [ 94, 201,  98] },
    { at: 30, rgb: [253, 231,  37] },
    { at: 40, rgb: [253, 100,  20] },
  ],
  TMAX: [
    { at:  5, rgb: [ 68,   1,  84] },
    { at: 15, rgb: [ 59,  82, 139] },
    { at: 25, rgb: [ 32, 144, 140] },
    { at: 35, rgb: [ 94, 201,  98] },
    { at: 40, rgb: [253, 231,  37] },
    { at: 45, rgb: [253, 100,  20] },
  ],
  TMIN: [
    { at: -10, rgb: [ 68,   1,  84] },

    { at:  35, rgb: [253, 100,  20] },

  // Sequential white→deep-blue for precipitation (annual totals in tropical
  // Africa commonly reach 1500-2500 mm — earlier 800 mm ceiling clamped

  PTOT: [
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Compute the geographic bbox of a GeoJSON feature (Polygon or
// MultiPolygon) in EPSG:4326. Includes a small percentage pad so the
// outline isn't flush against the rendered canvas edge.
featureBbox_E = (feature, padPct = 0.02) => {
  let xmin = Infinity, ymin = Infinity, xmax = -Infinity, ymax = -Infinity;
  const visit = (coords) => {
    if (typeof coords[0] === "number") {
      if (coords[0] < xmin) xmin = coords[0];
      if (coords[0] > xmax) xmax = coords[0];
      if (coords[1] < ymin) ymin = coords[1];
      if (coords[1] > ymax) ymax = coords[1];
    } else {
      for (const c of coords) visit(c);
    }
  };
  visit(feature.geometry.coordinates);
  const px = (xmax - xmin) * padPct;
  const py = (ymax - ymin) * padPct;
  return { xmin: xmin - px, ymin: ymin - py, xmax: xmax + px, ymax: ymax + py };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// COUNTRY-level raster cache. Depends ONLY on (country, variable,
// season, mapStat). Admin1 selection does NOT invalidate this cell —
// OJS dataflow gives us memoisation for free. Switching admin1 inside
// the same country re-runs only the render cell (sub-arrays the data
// already in memory) — no second COG fetch, no second HTTP Range
// request to S3.
countryRaster_E = {
  const f = admin0_feature_E;
  if (!f) return { error: `No admin0 polygon for ${country.iso3}.` };

  const bbox = featureBbox_E(f);
  const cogUrl = cogURL_for_E({ variable: variable_E, season: season_E, stat: mapStat_E });
  const t0 = performance.now();

  try {
    // 1. Open the COG. geotiff.js uses HTTP Range requests under the hood
    // so only the bytes for our pixel window get fetched — the full
    // Africa-wide raster never crosses the wire.
    const tiff = await GeoTIFF_E.fromUrl(cogUrl);
    const image = await tiff.getImage();

    // 2. Manual pixel window from image georef + country bbox. Don't
    // use readRasters({bbox}) — silently returns full raster for some
    // COG flavours in this collection (see commit history).
    const imgBbox = image.getBoundingBox();
    const imgW = image.getWidth();
    const imgH = image.getHeight();
    const xRes = (imgBbox[2] - imgBbox[0]) / imgW;
    const yRes = (imgBbox[3] - imgBbox[1]) / imgH;

    const wx1 = Math.max(0,    Math.floor((bbox.xmin  - imgBbox[0]) / xRes));
    const wy1 = Math.max(0,    Math.floor((imgBbox[3] - bbox.ymax)  / yRes));
    const wx2 = Math.min(imgW, Math.ceil ((bbox.xmax  - imgBbox[0]) / xRes));
    const wy2 = Math.min(imgH, Math.ceil ((imgBbox[3] - bbox.ymin)  / yRes));
    if (wx2 <= wx1 || wy2 <= wy1) {
      return { error: `Country bbox does not overlap COG extent.` };
    }

    const rasters = await image.readRasters({ window: [wx1, wy1, wx2, wy2] });
    const data = rasters[0];
    const w = rasters.width, h = rasters.height;

    // Snap geo-extent to the pixel window's actual edges.
    const actualBbox = {
      xmin: imgBbox[0] + wx1 * xRes,
      ymax: imgBbox[3] - wy1 * yRes,
      xmax: imgBbox[0] + wx2 * xRes,
      ymin: imgBbox[3] - wy2 * yRes,
    };

    // NoData sentinel handling (CR-076 etc.). Cache the resolver too
    // so the render cell doesn't re-derive it.
    const noData = typeof image.getGDALNoData === "function" ? image.getGDALNoData() : null;

    return {
      data, w, h, xRes, yRes,
      bbox: actualBbox,
      noData,
      cogUrl,
      fetchMs: performance.now() - t0,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("countryRaster_E fetch", e);
    return { error: String(e) };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
recentChangesMap_E = {
  if (countryRaster_E.error) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 1em; color: #c33;">${countryRaster_E.error}</div>`;
  }

  const W = 600;
  const status = html`<div style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #666; margin-bottom: 4px; min-height: 1.2em;"></div>`;
  const setStatus = (msg) => { status.textContent = msg; };

  // The full admin1 set for the current country — also used as the
  // mask AND the always-drawn boundary layer when no admin1 is
  // explicitly selected. Using the admin1 collection (rather than
  // admin0) for the mask means the mask edge and the drawn admin1
  // boundary line come from the SAME simplification source, so they
  // align perfectly. The admin0 file is simplified independently
  // and was producing a few-pixel offset against the admin1 lines —
  // we drop it from the SVG overlay entirely.
  const countryAdmin1Features = admin1_geo_E.features.filter((f) =>
    f.properties && f.properties.iso3 === country.iso3
  );

  // Render features (drives mask + bbox):
  //   0 admin1s selected → all country admin1s (≈ country shape)
  //   1+ admin1s selected → only the selected admin1s
  // The country raster covers admin0; sub-clipping just re-slices the
  // already-fetched typed array, no second HTTP fetch.
  const renderFeatures = admin1_features_E.length > 0
    ? admin1_features_E
    : (countryAdmin1Features.length > 0 ? countryAdmin1Features : [admin0_feature_E]);
  const renderLabel =
    admin1_features_E.length === 0 ? country.name :
    admin1_features_E.length === 1 ? `${admin1_features_E[0].properties.admin1_name}, ${country.name}` :
    `${country.name} (${admin1_features_E.length} admin1s)`;

  // Union bbox across selected features, then pad.
  const featBboxes = renderFeatures.map((f) => featureBbox_E(f, 0));
  const unionRaw = featBboxes.reduce((acc, b) => ({
    xmin: Math.min(acc.xmin, b.xmin), ymin: Math.min(acc.ymin, b.ymin),
    xmax: Math.max(acc.xmax, b.xmax), ymax: Math.max(acc.ymax, b.ymax),
  }), { xmin: Infinity, ymin: Infinity, xmax: -Infinity, ymax: -Infinity });
  const padPct = 0.02;
  const renderBbox = {
    xmin: unionRaw.xmin - (unionRaw.xmax - unionRaw.xmin) * padPct,
    ymin: unionRaw.ymin - (unionRaw.ymax - unionRaw.ymin) * padPct,
    xmax: unionRaw.xmax + (unionRaw.xmax - unionRaw.xmin) * padPct,
    ymax: unionRaw.ymax + (unionRaw.ymax - unionRaw.ymin) * padPct,
  };

  // Sub-pixel window inside the cached country data corresponding to
  // the render bbox. If admin1, this is a small sub-rectangle of the
  // already-fetched array.
  const { data, w: cw, h: ch, bbox: cbbox } = countryRaster_E;
  const cxRes = (cbbox.xmax - cbbox.xmin) / cw;
  const cyRes = (cbbox.ymax - cbbox.ymin) / ch;
  let sx1 = Math.max(0,  Math.floor((renderBbox.xmin - cbbox.xmin) / cxRes));
  let sy1 = Math.max(0,  Math.floor((cbbox.ymax - renderBbox.ymax) / cyRes));
  let sx2 = Math.min(cw, Math.ceil ((renderBbox.xmax - cbbox.xmin) / cxRes));
  let sy2 = Math.min(ch, Math.ceil ((cbbox.ymax - renderBbox.ymin) / cyRes));
  if (sx2 <= sx1 || sy2 <= sy1) {
    sx1 = 0; sy1 = 0; sx2 = cw; sy2 = ch;
  }
  const sw = sx2 - sx1, sh = sy2 - sy1;
  const actualRenderBbox = {
    xmin: cbbox.xmin + sx1 * cxRes,
    ymax: cbbox.ymax - sy1 * cyRes,
    xmax: cbbox.xmin + sx2 * cxRes,
    ymin: cbbox.ymax - sy2 * cyRes,
  };

  const noData = countryRaster_E.noData;
  const isNoData = (v) => {
    if (!isFinite(v)) return true;
    if (noData != null && v === noData) return true;
    if (v <= -9999) return true;
    return false;
  };

  // First pass: scan sub-window to learn min / max of the visible
  // data so we can build a data-driven ramp. We need this BEFORE
  // painting so the colours match the legend.
  let nValid = 0, vMin = Infinity, vMax = -Infinity;
  for (let row = 0; row < sh; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < sw; col++) {
      const v = data[(sy1 + row) * cw + (sx1 + col)];
      if (isNoData(v)) continue;
      nValid++;
      if (v < vMin) vMin = v;
      if (v > vMax) vMax = v;
    }
  }

  // Ramp selection.
  //   `globalStops` = the fixed cross-region ramp from ramps_E.
  //   `activeStops` = what we'll actually draw with. Either the global
  //   stops (toggle on) OR a rescaled version where the original
  //   stops' `at` values get linearly remapped to [vMin, vMax]. The
  //   colour sequence is preserved; only the breakpoints move. The
  //   legend ticks match what's drawn.
  const globalStops = ramps_E[variable_E] ?? ramps_E.TAVG;
  let activeStops = globalStops;
  let rampLabel = "fixed";
  if (!rampLockFixed_E && nValid > 1 && vMax > vMin) {
    const g0 = globalStops[0].at;
    const g1 = globalStops[globalStops.length - 1].at;
    const gRange = g1 - g0;
    const newRange = vMax - vMin;
    activeStops = globalStops.map((s) => ({
      at: vMin + ((s.at - g0) / gRange) * newRange,
      rgb: s.rgb,
    }));
    rampLabel = "dynamic";
  }

  // Second pass: paint each sub-window pixel via the active ramp.
  const offscreen = document.createElement("canvas");
  offscreen.width = sw;
  offscreen.height = sh;
  const offCtx = offscreen.getContext("2d");
  const img = offCtx.createImageData(sw, sh);
  for (let row = 0; row < sh; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < sw; col++) {
      const v = data[(sy1 + row) * cw + (sx1 + col)];
      if (isNoData(v)) continue;
      const c = colorRamp_E(v, activeStops);
      if (c) {
        const j = (row * sw + col) * 4;
        img.data[j]     = c[0];
        img.data[j + 1] = c[1];
        img.data[j + 2] = c[2];
        img.data[j + 3] = c[3];
      }
    }
  }
  offCtx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

  const H = Math.round(W * sh / sw);
  const display = document.createElement("canvas");
  display.width = W;
  display.height = H;
  display.style.display = "block";
  display.style.border = "1px solid #ddd";
  display.style.background = "#fafafa";
  const dctx = display.getContext("2d");
  dctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  dctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";

  // Geographic ↔ canvas-pixel projection.
  const tx = (lon) => (lon - actualRenderBbox.xmin) / (actualRenderBbox.xmax - actualRenderBbox.xmin) * W;
  const ty = (lat) => (actualRenderBbox.ymax - lat) / (actualRenderBbox.ymax - actualRenderBbox.ymin) * H;

  // Build a Path2D in canvas-pixel space from a GeoJSON feature.
  // Used for BOTH the canvas mask AND (via path-d string) the SVG
  // outline so the two stay perfectly aligned.
  const buildPath2D = (feature) => {
    const p = new Path2D();
    const addRing = (ring) => {
      ring.forEach(([lo, la], i) => {
        const x = tx(lo);
        const y = ty(la);
        if (i === 0) p.moveTo(x, y);
        else p.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      p.closePath();
    };
    const g = feature.geometry;
    if (g.type === "Polygon") g.coordinates.forEach(addRing);
    else if (g.type === "MultiPolygon") g.coordinates.forEach((poly) => poly.forEach(addRing));
    return p;
  };

  // Mask: clip to the union of render features (admin0 if no admin1s
  // selected, else the union of selected admin1s). evenodd winding
  // correctly carves out polygon holes (GeoJSON outer-ring CCW + holes
  // CW). Painting happens *inside* save/restore so the clip doesn't
  // leak into the next render.
  const combinedMask = new Path2D();
  renderFeatures.forEach((f) => combinedMask.addPath(buildPath2D(f)));
  dctx.save();
  dctx.clip(combinedMask, "evenodd");
  dctx.drawImage(offscreen, 0, 0, W, H);
  dctx.restore();

  // SVG overlay: admin0 always drawn (thin); each selected admin1
  // drawn bolder. SVG markup is parsed as image/svg+xml so every
  // <path> lands in the SVG namespace (the previous nested-html
  // template was silently producing HTMLUnknownElements — invisible
  // inside an SVG parent).
  const ringToPath = (ring) => "M" + ring.map(([lo, la]) => `${tx(lo).toFixed(1)},${ty(la).toFixed(1)}`).join("L") + "Z";
  const featureToPath = (feat) => {
    const g = feat.geometry;
    if (g.type === "Polygon") return g.coordinates.map(ringToPath).join(" ");
    if (g.type === "MultiPolygon") return g.coordinates.flatMap((poly) => poly.map(ringToPath)).join(" ");
    return "";
  };
  // Boundary layers:
  //   1. ALL country admin1 boundaries — thin gray (provides context
  //      + traces the country shape since admin1s tile it).
  //   2. SELECTED admin1 boundaries — bold red with a white halo for
  //      accent. Drawn on top so the selection is unambiguous against
  //      any colour ramp underneath.
  // admin0 outline deliberately omitted — using it next to the
  // admin1 layer produced visible 1–3 px ghosting because the two
  // topojsons are simplified independently.
  const allAdmin1Paths      = countryAdmin1Features.map(featureToPath).join(" ");
  const selectedAdmin1Paths = admin1_features_E.map(featureToPath).join(" ");

  // Optional graticule layer — nice round-number lat/lon ticks via
  // d3.ticks. Drawn as small black lines at the canvas edges + text
  // labels. Cheap (~10 ticks total) so we just build it every render
  // when the toggle is on.
  let graticuleMarkup = "";
  if (showGraticule_E) {
    const tickStroke = "#333";
    const lonTicks = d3.ticks(actualRenderBbox.xmin, actualRenderBbox.xmax, 5);
    const latTicks = d3.ticks(actualRenderBbox.ymin, actualRenderBbox.ymax, 5);
    const fmt = (v) => v.toFixed(Math.abs(v) >= 10 ? 0 : 1);
    const lonAxis = lonTicks.map((lo) => {
      const x = tx(lo);
      return `<line x1="${x.toFixed(1)}" x2="${x.toFixed(1)}" y1="${H - 6}" y2="${H}" stroke="${tickStroke}" stroke-width="0.8"/>
              <text x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="${tickStroke}" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2">${fmt(lo)}°${lo >= 0 ? "E" : "W"}</text>`;
    }).join("");
    const latAxis = latTicks.map((la) => {
      const y = ty(la);
      return `<line x1="0" x2="6" y1="${y.toFixed(1)}" y2="${y.toFixed(1)}" stroke="${tickStroke}" stroke-width="0.8"/>
              <text x="8" y="${(y + 3).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="start" font-size="9" fill="${tickStroke}" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2">${fmt(Math.abs(la))}°${la >= 0 ? "N" : "S"}</text>`;
    }).join("");
    graticuleMarkup = lonAxis + latAxis;
  }

  // Optional admin1 name labels — only for admin1s belonging to the
  // current country whose polygon centroid falls inside the render
  // bbox. d3.geoCentroid does the spherical-correct centroid (the
  // arithmetic-mean of coords would skew on long thin polygons).
  // Halo via paint-order:stroke + white stroke for readability over
  // varied raster colours. No collision-avoidance — for the sandbox
  // it's enough.
  let labelsMarkup = "";
  if (showAdmin1Labels_E) {
    const iso3 = country.iso3;
    // Centroid resolver — prefer d3.geoCentroid (spherical-correct,
    // robust to long thin polygons) and fall back to bbox-center if
    // the d3 bundle this notebook loads doesn't include d3-geo.
    const centroidOf = (f) => {
      if (typeof d3.geoCentroid === "function") return d3.geoCentroid(f);
      const b = featureBbox_E(f, 0);
      return [(b.xmin + b.xmax) / 2, (b.ymin + b.ymax) / 2];
    };
    labelsMarkup = admin1_geo_E.features
      .filter((f) => f.properties && f.properties.iso3 === iso3)
      .map((f) => ({ f, c: centroidOf(f) }))
      .filter(({ c }) =>
        c[0] >= actualRenderBbox.xmin && c[0] <= actualRenderBbox.xmax &&
        c[1] >= actualRenderBbox.ymin && c[1] <= actualRenderBbox.ymax
      )
      .map(({ f, c }) => {
        const x = tx(c[0]).toFixed(1);
        const y = ty(c[1]).toFixed(1);
        const name = escapeXml_E(f.properties.admin1_name || "");
        return `<text x="${x}" y="${y}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#111" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round">${name}</text>`;
      })
      .join("");
  }

  const svgMarkup = `
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}" style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; pointer-events: none;">
      <path d="${allAdmin1Paths}" stroke="#555" stroke-width="0.7" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
      ${selectedAdmin1Paths ? `
        <path d="${selectedAdmin1Paths}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4.5" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="${selectedAdmin1Paths}" stroke="#d62728" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      ` : ""}
      ${graticuleMarkup}
      ${labelsMarkup}
    </svg>
  `;
  const svgOverlay = new DOMParser()
    .parseFromString(svgMarkup, "image/svg+xml")
    .documentElement;

  const legend = buildLegend_E(activeStops, variable_E, mapStat_E);

  const mapStack = html`<div style="position: relative; width: ${W}px;"></div>`;
  mapStack.appendChild(display);
  mapStack.appendChild(svgOverlay);

  // Download button. Composites the data canvas + SVG overlay into a
  // single PNG (renders the SVG via an Image off a Blob URL — the
  // standard pattern for "save what's on screen" with stacked canvas
  // + SVG layers).
  const dlBtn = html`<button style="margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.85em;">Download map (PNG)</button>`;
  dlBtn.onclick = async () => {
    const composite = document.createElement("canvas");
    composite.width = W;
    composite.height = H;
    const cctx = composite.getContext("2d");
    cctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    cctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    cctx.drawImage(display, 0, 0);
    const svgString = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgOverlay);
    const svgBlob = new Blob([svgString], { type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8" });
    const svgUrl = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const im = new Image();
      im.onload = () => { cctx.drawImage(im, 0, 0); URL.revokeObjectURL(svgUrl); resolve(); };
      im.onerror = (e) => { URL.revokeObjectURL(svgUrl); reject(e); };
      im.src = svgUrl;
    });
    composite.toBlob((blob) => {
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      const slug = (renderLabel || "map").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, "_");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = `obs_${variable_E}_${season_E}_${mapStat_E}_${slug}.png`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }, "image/png");
  };

  const statLabel = mapStat_E === "mean" ? "1991-2020 mean" : `1991-2020 ${mapStat_E}`;
  const fetchSec = (countryRaster_E.fetchMs / 1000).toFixed(1);
  const rangeStr = nValid > 0 ? `data range [${vMin.toFixed(2)}, ${vMax.toFixed(2)}]` : "no valid pixels";
  setStatus(`${variable_E} ${season_E} (${statLabel}) for ${renderLabel} · country fetch ${fetchSec}s · sub-window ${sw}×${sh} → ${W}×${H} · ${rangeStr} · ramp: ${rampLabel}`);

  const header = html`<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px;">${status}${dlBtn}</div>`;
  return html`<div>${header}${mapStack}${legend}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// XML/HTML-attribute escape for text we inject into raw SVG markup
// strings (admin1 names contain accented characters and could in
// theory contain quote / angle-bracket chars that would break the
// surrounding XML). Standalone cell — the chained .replace regex
// literals are kept far from any top-level object literal, mirroring
// the extremeColour_E split that fixed an earlier OJS parser issue.
escapeXml_E = (str) => String(str)
  .split("&").join("&amp;")
  .split("<").join("&lt;")
  .split(">").join("&gt;")
  .split('"').join("&quot;");
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Legend renderer — horizontal colour bar with tick marks at every stop.
// The gradient mirrors colorRamp_E (linear RGB interp between stops),
// rendered via SVG <linearGradient>.
buildLegend_E = (stops, variable, stat) => {
  const W = 600;
  const barH = 14;
  const padTop = 6, padBottom = 22, padX = 8;
  const totalH = padTop + barH + padBottom;

  const v0 = stops[0].at;
  const v1 = stops[stops.length - 1].at;
  const range = v1 - v0;
  const xForVal = (v) => padX + (v - v0) / range * (W - 2 * padX);

  const gradientId = "legend-grad-" + variable.split("-").join("_") + "-" + stat;
  const gradientStops = stops.map((s) => {
    const pct = ((s.at - v0) / range * 100).toFixed(2);
    return `<stop offset="${pct}%" stop-color="rgb(${s.rgb.join(",")})" />`;
  }).join("");

  const ticks = stops.map((s) => {
    const x = xForVal(s.at);
    const label = Math.abs(s.at) >= 100 ? Math.round(s.at) : (Math.abs(s.at) >= 10 ? s.at.toFixed(0) : s.at.toFixed(1));
    return `
      <line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${padTop}" y2="${padTop + barH + 3}" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.8"/>
      <text x="${x}" y="${padTop + barH + 16}" font-size="10" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif">${label}</text>
    `;
  }).join("");

  const unit = variable === "PTOT" ? "mm" : variable.startsWith("SPEI") ? (stat === "sd" ? "σ (z)" : "z") : "°C";
  const titleText = `${variable} (${stat}) — ${unit}`;

  const svgMarkup = `
    <svg width="${W}" height="${totalH}" style="display:block; margin-top: 6px;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="${gradientId}" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
          ${gradientStops}
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <rect x="${padX}" y="${padTop}" width="${W - 2 * padX}" height="${barH}" fill="url(#${gradientId})" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.6"/>
      ${ticks}
    </svg>
  `;
  const container = html`<div style="font-size: 11px; color: #333; margin-top: 4px;">
    <div style="font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 2px;">${titleText}</div>
  </div>`;
  // Build SVG DOM from markup string
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(svgMarkup, "image/svg+xml");
  const svgEl = document.importNode(doc.documentElement, true);
  container.appendChild(svgEl);
  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
{
  const div = document.getElementById("recent-changes-map-wrap-E");
  if (div) div.replaceChildren(recentChangesMap_E);
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
**Sandbox notes**

- **No-overviews caveat (CR-076 follow-up).** The COGs were baked with `OVERVIEWS=NONE` (per `R/observational/5_make_obs_map_climatologies.R` `cog_gdal_opts`). Without overviews, geotiff.js has to read full-resolution data even for low-zoom views — fine at country scale where the country bbox already gives a modest source size, but it's worth rebaking with proper overviews if this layer is ever deployed at continental zoom.
- **Polygon pixel-mask not applied** — the COG's existing NaN/NoData masks ocean/non-Africa pixels, but admin0 polygon-cut clipping is deferred to the production view (would need `gdalwarp --cutline` server-side per country, or client-side canvas-clip masking via the SVG path).
- **COG URL is hard-coded** to the CR-076 single-physical-directory layout. Once CR-076 lands, the path template in `cogURL_for_E` needs updating.
- **CR-075 short-term filter** applied — disputed-territory polygons for EGY/KEN/SDN are dropped via the `mainGaul` selector (timeseries side; the map side renders only the main admin0 feature).
- **Forward-compat note**: if we later want pan / zoom / drag, OpenLayers `WebGLTileLayer` is a drop-in upgrade that uses the same geotiff.js underneath — so this COG-read + bbox-extraction logic carries forward unchanged.
:::
